import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { readFile, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const HERE = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(HERE), "../..");
const GENERATOR_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "scripts/hard-decoy/v3-vhh-sequence-pregraph.mjs");
const CONTRACT_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "validation/hard-decoy-holdout-v3/vhh-sequence-contract-2026-08-29.json");
const CORRECTION_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "validation/hard-decoy-holdout-v3/VHH_NUMBERING_CORRECTION_2026-08-30.json");
const PACKAGE_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "package.json");
const LOCK_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "package-lock.json");
const TEST_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "tests/hard-decoy-v3-vhh-sequence-pregraph.test.mjs");
const AUDIT_PATH = path.join(ROOT, "tests/hard-decoy-v3-vhh-sequence-pregraph-snapshot-audit.test.mjs");
const SHA256 = /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u;
const REQUIRED_REGIONS = [
  "FR1-IMGT",
  "CDR1-IMGT",
  "FR2-IMGT",
  "CDR2-IMGT",
  "FR3-IMGT",
  "CDR3-IMGT",
  "FR4-IMGT",
];

function ok(value, message) {
  if (!value) throw new Error(message);
}

function sha256(bytes) {
  return createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
}

function occurrences(text, fragment) {
  return text.split(fragment).length - 1;
}

function replaceOnce(text, before, after, label) {
  if (text.includes(after)) return text;
  const count = occurrences(text, before);
  ok(count === 1, `${label} expected one source fragment, observed ${count}.`);
  return text.replace(before, after);
}

async function writeJson(filename, value) {
  await writeFile(filename, `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`);
}

function correctionRecord() {
  return {
    schemaVersion: "1.0.0",
    studyId: "confovhh-hard-decoy-holdout-v3",
    recordDateUtc: "2026-08-30",
    status: "PRELABEL_NUMBERING_ENGINE_CORRECTION_APPLIED_BEFORE_TARGET_FREEZE",
    supersededUnmergedArtifact: {
      pullRequest: 14,
      headCommitBeforeCorrection: "4a88fa9567e4b87470718e8acb426a6dad303bc4",
      numberingEngine: "immunum 1.2.0",
      formalBenchmarkAuthority: false,
    },
    finding: {
      code: "LONG_CDR3_SUFFIX_CLIPPING_BEFORE_FR4",
      representativeProfileId: "candidate:3SN6#entity:5",
      observedTruncatedCdr3: "AR",
      sequenceAnchoredCompleteCdr3: "ARCPAPFTRDCFDVTSTTYAY",
      sequenceAnchoredCompleteCdr3Length: 21,
      consequence: "framework-and-CDR3-leakage-comparisons-could-be-biologically-misclassified",
      nativeCoordinatesInspected: false,
      nativeRelativePoseInspected: false,
    },
    upstreamCorrection: {
      package: "immunum",
      fromVersion: "1.2.0",
      toVersion: "1.3.0",
      releaseTag: "v1.3.0",
      releaseCommit: "e027d5fe2405300508eee7ce78582a2fe4990f20",
      releaseDateUtc: "2026-08-28",
      officialChangelogUrl: "https://github.com/ENPICOM/immunum/blob/e027d5fe2405300508eee7ce78582a2fe4990f20/CHANGELOG.md",
      statedCorrection: "ultralong-CDR3-domains-are-no-longer-suffix-clipped-before-FR4",
    },
    remediation: [
      "pin-immunum-1.3.0-in-package-and-lock-files",
      "bind-the-exact-package-lock-digest-into-the-frozen-numbering-contract",
      "require-nonempty-FR1-CDR1-FR2-CDR2-FR3-CDR3-and-FR4",
      "require-exact-agreement-between-number-map-derived-and-segment-derived-regions",
      "regenerate-every-profile-pair-matrix-row-and-component",
      "independently-replay-pair-space-threshold-and-sequence-reuse-accounting",
    ],
    accessBoundary: {
      nativeHoldoutCoordinatesAccessed: false,
      nativeRelativePosesInspected: false,
      nativeEpitopesAccessed: false,
      dockqOrCapriLabelsAccessed: false,
      confovhhHoldoutScoresAccessed: false,
      performanceResultsAccessed: false,
    },
    authorization: {
      formallyClearedGroupCount: 0,
      targetFreezePermitted: false,
      executionAuthorized: false,
    },
  };
}

async function prepare() {
  const packageJson = JSON.parse(await readFile(PACKAGE_PATH, "utf8"));
  ok(packageJson.dependencies?.immunum === "1.2.0" || packageJson.dependencies?.immunum === "1.3.0", "Unexpected immunum package requirement.");
  packageJson.dependencies.immunum = "1.3.0";
  await writeJson(PACKAGE_PATH, packageJson);

  const correction = correctionRecord();
  await writeJson(CORRECTION_PATH, correction);
  const correctionDigest = sha256(await readFile(CORRECTION_PATH));

  const contract = JSON.parse(await readFile(CONTRACT_PATH, "utf8"));
  ok(contract.studyId === "confovhh-hard-decoy-holdout-v3" && contract.status === "VHH_SEQUENCE_PREGRAPH_RULE_FROZEN", "Unexpected VHH contract identity.");
  contract.schemaVersion = "1.1.0";
  contract.numbering.engine = "immunum 1.3.0";
  contract.numbering.engineReleaseTag = "v1.3.0";
  contract.numbering.engineReleaseCommit = "e027d5fe2405300508eee7ce78582a2fe4990f20";
  contract.numbering.engineReleaseDateUtc = "2026-08-28";
  contract.numbering.engineUpgradeReason = "correct-ultralong-CDR3-suffix-clipping-before-FR4";
  contract.numbering.requiredImgtRegions = REQUIRED_REGIONS;
  contract.numbering.completeImgtRegionCoverageRequired = true;
  contract.numbering.numberingSegmentationAgreementRequired = true;
  contract.numbering.incompleteRegionPolicy = "fail-closed";
  contract.numbering.segmentationCrossCheck = "number-map-derived-and-segment-derived-regions-must-agree-exactly";
  contract.numbering.packageLockPath = "package-lock.json";
  if (!SHA256.test(contract.numbering.packageLockSha256 ?? "")) contract.numbering.packageLockSha256 = null;
  contract.numbering.correctionRecordPath = "validation/hard-decoy-holdout-v3/VHH_NUMBERING_CORRECTION_2026-08-30.json";
  contract.numbering.correctionRecordSha256 = correctionDigest;
  await writeJson(CONTRACT_PATH, contract);

  let generator = await readFile(GENERATOR_PATH, "utf8");
  const oldEngineCount = occurrences(generator, "immunum 1.2.0");
  ok(oldEngineCount === 0 || oldEngineCount === 2, `Unexpected old-engine occurrence count: ${oldEngineCount}.`);
  generator = generator.replaceAll("immunum 1.2.0", "immunum 1.3.0");
  generator = generator.replace('contract.schemaVersion === "1.0.0"', 'contract.schemaVersion === "1.1.0"');

  generator = replaceOnce(
    generator,
    `    cdr3Sequence: null,\n    cdr3Length: null,\n    cdr3SequenceSha256: null,\n  };`,
    `    cdr3Sequence: null,\n    cdr3Length: null,\n    cdr3SequenceSha256: null,\n    imgtRegionLengths: null,\n    completeImgtRegionCoverage: false,\n    numberingSegmentationAgreement: false,\n  };`,
    "VHH numbering base fields",
  );

  generator = replaceOnce(
    generator,
    `    const framework = [];\n    const cdr3 = [];\n    for (let offset = 0; offset < entries.length; offset += 1) {\n      const [position, aminoAcid] = entries[offset];\n      const sequenceIndex = result.query_start + offset;\n      if (normalized[sequenceIndex] !== aminoAcid || !CANONICAL_AA.test(aminoAcid)) {\n        return {\n          ...base,\n          numberingFailureCode: "NUMBERING_SEQUENCE_MAP_MISMATCH",\n          numberingFailureMessage: "The numbered residues did not map exactly to the source sequence.",\n        };\n      }\n      const region = imgtRegion(position);\n      if (["FR1-IMGT", "FR2-IMGT", "FR3-IMGT", "FR4-IMGT"].includes(region)) framework.push(aminoAcid);\n      else if (region === "CDR3-IMGT") cdr3.push(aminoAcid);\n    }\n    const frameworkSequence = framework.join("");\n    const cdr3Sequence = cdr3.join("");\n    if (!frameworkSequence || !cdr3Sequence) {\n      return {\n        ...base,\n        numberingFailureCode: "EMPTY_FRAMEWORK_OR_CDR3",\n        numberingFailureMessage: "IMGT numbering did not yield both a framework sequence and CDR3.",\n      };\n    }`,
    `    const requiredRegions = ["FR1-IMGT", "CDR1-IMGT", "FR2-IMGT", "CDR2-IMGT", "FR3-IMGT", "CDR3-IMGT", "FR4-IMGT"];\n    const residuesByRegion = Object.fromEntries(requiredRegions.map((region) => [region, []]));\n    for (let offset = 0; offset < entries.length; offset += 1) {\n      const [position, aminoAcid] = entries[offset];\n      const sequenceIndex = result.query_start + offset;\n      if (normalized[sequenceIndex] !== aminoAcid || !CANONICAL_AA.test(aminoAcid)) {\n        return {\n          ...base,\n          numberingFailureCode: "NUMBERING_SEQUENCE_MAP_MISMATCH",\n          numberingFailureMessage: "The numbered residues did not map exactly to the source sequence.",\n        };\n      }\n      const region = imgtRegion(position);\n      if (residuesByRegion[region]) residuesByRegion[region].push(aminoAcid);\n    }\n    const mapSegments = {\n      fr1: residuesByRegion["FR1-IMGT"].join(""),\n      cdr1: residuesByRegion["CDR1-IMGT"].join(""),\n      fr2: residuesByRegion["FR2-IMGT"].join(""),\n      cdr2: residuesByRegion["CDR2-IMGT"].join(""),\n      fr3: residuesByRegion["FR3-IMGT"].join(""),\n      cdr3: residuesByRegion["CDR3-IMGT"].join(""),\n      fr4: residuesByRegion["FR4-IMGT"].join(""),\n    };\n    const segmented = annotator.segment(normalized);\n    if (segmented.error) {\n      return {\n        ...base,\n        numberingFailureCode: "NUMBERING_SEGMENTATION_ERROR",\n        numberingFailureMessage: boundedErrorMessage(segmented.error) ?? "The pinned numbering engine could not segment the V-domain.",\n      };\n    }\n    const requiredSegmentNames = ["fr1", "cdr1", "fr2", "cdr2", "fr3", "cdr3", "fr4"];\n    if (requiredSegmentNames.some((name) => typeof segmented[name] !== "string" || segmented[name].length === 0 || mapSegments[name].length === 0)) {\n      return {\n        ...base,\n        numberingFailureCode: "INCOMPLETE_IMGT_V_DOMAIN",\n        numberingFailureMessage: "IMGT numbering must yield nonempty FR1, CDR1, FR2, CDR2, FR3, CDR3, and FR4 regions.",\n      };\n    }\n    if (requiredSegmentNames.some((name) => segmented[name] !== mapSegments[name])) {\n      return {\n        ...base,\n        numberingFailureCode: "NUMBERING_SEGMENTATION_MISMATCH",\n        numberingFailureMessage: "Number-map-derived and segment-derived IMGT regions disagree.",\n      };\n    }\n    const frameworkSequence = [segmented.fr1, segmented.fr2, segmented.fr3, segmented.fr4].join("");\n    const cdr3Sequence = segmented.cdr3;\n    const imgtRegionLengths = {\n      "FR1-IMGT": segmented.fr1.length,\n      "CDR1-IMGT": segmented.cdr1.length,\n      "FR2-IMGT": segmented.fr2.length,\n      "CDR2-IMGT": segmented.cdr2.length,\n      "FR3-IMGT": segmented.fr3.length,\n      "CDR3-IMGT": segmented.cdr3.length,\n      "FR4-IMGT": segmented.fr4.length,\n    };`,
    "complete IMGT region extraction",
  );

  generator = replaceOnce(
    generator,
    `      cdr3SequenceSha256: sha256(Buffer.from(cdr3Sequence)),\n    };`,
    `      cdr3SequenceSha256: sha256(Buffer.from(cdr3Sequence)),\n      imgtRegionLengths,\n      completeImgtRegionCoverage: true,\n      numberingSegmentationAgreement: true,\n    };`,
    "successful numbering coverage fields",
  );

  generator = replaceOnce(
    generator,
    `  if (profile.numberingStatus === "NUMBERED") {\n    ok(profile.numberingFailureCode === null && profile.numberingFailureMessage === null, \`\${profile.profileId} reports a failure despite successful numbering.\`);\n    ok(CANONICAL_AA.test(profile.frameworkSequence) && CANONICAL_AA.test(profile.cdr3Sequence), \`\${profile.profileId} emitted a noncanonical numbered region.\`);\n    ok(profile.frameworkLength === profile.frameworkSequence.length && profile.cdr3Length === profile.cdr3Sequence.length, \`\${profile.profileId} numbered-region lengths drifted.\`);\n    ok(sha256(Buffer.from(profile.frameworkSequence)) === profile.frameworkSequenceSha256, \`\${profile.profileId} framework digest drifted.\`);\n    ok(sha256(Buffer.from(profile.cdr3Sequence)) === profile.cdr3SequenceSha256, \`\${profile.profileId} CDR3 digest drifted.\`);\n  } else {\n    ok(profile.numberingStatus === "UNAVAILABLE" && typeof profile.numberingFailureCode === "string", \`\${profile.profileId} has an invalid numbering state.\`);\n    for (const field of ["frameworkSequence", "frameworkLength", "frameworkSequenceSha256", "cdr3Sequence", "cdr3Length", "cdr3SequenceSha256"]) {\n      ok(profile[field] === null, \`\${profile.profileId} retains numbered-region data despite unavailable numbering: \${field}\`);\n    }\n  }`,
    `  const requiredRegions = contract.numbering.requiredImgtRegions;\n  ok(canonical(requiredRegions) === canonical(["FR1-IMGT", "CDR1-IMGT", "FR2-IMGT", "CDR2-IMGT", "FR3-IMGT", "CDR3-IMGT", "FR4-IMGT"]), \`\${profile.profileId} required IMGT-region contract drifted.\`);\n  if (profile.numberingStatus === "NUMBERED") {\n    ok(profile.numberingFailureCode === null && profile.numberingFailureMessage === null, \`\${profile.profileId} reports a failure despite successful numbering.\`);\n    ok(profile.completeImgtRegionCoverage === true && profile.numberingSegmentationAgreement === true, \`\${profile.profileId} lacks complete independently cross-checked IMGT regions.\`);\n    ok(profile.imgtRegionLengths && typeof profile.imgtRegionLengths === "object" && !Array.isArray(profile.imgtRegionLengths), \`\${profile.profileId} lacks IMGT region-length evidence.\`);\n    for (const region of requiredRegions) ok(Number.isSafeInteger(profile.imgtRegionLengths[region]) && profile.imgtRegionLengths[region] > 0, \`\${profile.profileId} has an invalid or empty IMGT region: \${region}\`);\n    ok(CANONICAL_AA.test(profile.frameworkSequence) && CANONICAL_AA.test(profile.cdr3Sequence), \`\${profile.profileId} emitted a noncanonical numbered region.\`);\n    ok(profile.frameworkLength === profile.frameworkSequence.length && profile.cdr3Length === profile.cdr3Sequence.length, \`\${profile.profileId} numbered-region lengths drifted.\`);\n    const expectedFrameworkLength = ["FR1-IMGT", "FR2-IMGT", "FR3-IMGT", "FR4-IMGT"].reduce((sum, region) => sum + profile.imgtRegionLengths[region], 0);\n    ok(profile.frameworkLength === expectedFrameworkLength && profile.cdr3Length === profile.imgtRegionLengths["CDR3-IMGT"], \`\${profile.profileId} IMGT region accounting drifted.\`);\n    ok(sha256(Buffer.from(profile.frameworkSequence)) === profile.frameworkSequenceSha256, \`\${profile.profileId} framework digest drifted.\`);\n    ok(sha256(Buffer.from(profile.cdr3Sequence)) === profile.cdr3SequenceSha256, \`\${profile.profileId} CDR3 digest drifted.\`);\n  } else {\n    ok(profile.numberingStatus === "UNAVAILABLE" && typeof profile.numberingFailureCode === "string", \`\${profile.profileId} has an invalid numbering state.\`);\n    for (const field of ["frameworkSequence", "frameworkLength", "frameworkSequenceSha256", "cdr3Sequence", "cdr3Length", "cdr3SequenceSha256", "imgtRegionLengths"]) {\n      ok(profile[field] === null, \`\${profile.profileId} retains numbered-region data despite unavailable numbering: \${field}\`);\n    }\n    ok(profile.completeImgtRegionCoverage === false && profile.numberingSegmentationAgreement === false, \`\${profile.profileId} unavailable numbering improperly claims complete region coverage.\`);\n  }`,
    "profile region validation",
  );

  generator = replaceOnce(
    generator,
    `  ok(contract.numbering.engine === "immunum 1.3.0" && contract.numbering.scheme === "IMGT" && contract.numbering.minimumEngineConfidence === 0.5, "Frozen VHH numbering policy drifted.");`,
    `  ok(contract.numbering.engine === "immunum 1.3.0" && contract.numbering.scheme === "IMGT" && contract.numbering.minimumEngineConfidence === 0.5, "Frozen VHH numbering policy drifted.");\n  ok(contract.numbering.completeImgtRegionCoverageRequired === true && contract.numbering.numberingSegmentationAgreementRequired === true, "Frozen IMGT completeness policy drifted.");\n  ok(contract.numbering.packageLockPath === "package-lock.json" && SHA256.test(contract.numbering.packageLockSha256), "Frozen numbering dependency-lock binding drifted.");\n  ok(typeof contract.numbering.correctionRecordPath === "string" && SHA256.test(contract.numbering.correctionRecordSha256), "Frozen numbering correction-record binding drifted.");`,
    "contract numbering integrity assertions",
  );

  generator = replaceOnce(
    generator,
    `  const exactSnapshotDirectory = path.join(root, contract.nodeUniverse.snapshotDirectory);`,
    `  const dependencyLockFile = await readDirect(root, contract.numbering.packageLockPath, "pinned dependency lock", 2 * 1024 * 1024);\n  ok(dependencyLockFile.sha256 === contract.numbering.packageLockSha256, "Pinned dependency lock digest drifted.");\n  const correctionRecordFile = await readDirect(root, contract.numbering.correctionRecordPath, "VHH numbering correction record", 512 * 1024);\n  ok(correctionRecordFile.sha256 === contract.numbering.correctionRecordSha256, "VHH numbering correction-record digest drifted.");\n\n  const exactSnapshotDirectory = path.join(root, contract.nodeUniverse.snapshotDirectory);`,
    "dependency and correction-record input binding",
  );

  generator = replaceOnce(
    generator,
    `      contract: contractFile.sha256,\n      selectedProtocol: protocolFile.sha256,`,
    `      contract: contractFile.sha256,\n      dependencyPackageLock: dependencyLockFile.sha256,\n      numberingCorrectionRecord: correctionRecordFile.sha256,\n      selectedProtocol: protocolFile.sha256,`,
    "manifest dependency provenance",
  );

  await writeFile(GENERATOR_PATH, generator);

  let testSource = await readFile(TEST_PATH, "utf8");
  testSource = testSource.replaceAll("immunum 1.2.0", "immunum 1.3.0");
  if (!testSource.includes("const NB35_SEQUENCE")) {
    testSource = replaceOnce(
      testSource,
      `const NANOBODY_SEQUENCE = "QVQLQESGGGLVQAGGSLRLSCAASGSIFSINTMGWYRQAPGKQRELVAAIHSGGSTNYANSVKGRFTISRDNAANTVYLQMNSLKPEDTAVYYCNVKDYGAVLYEYDYWGQGTQVTVSSHHHHHH";`,
      `const NANOBODY_SEQUENCE = "QVQLQESGGGLVQAGGSLRLSCAASGSIFSINTMGWYRQAPGKQRELVAAIHSGGSTNYANSVKGRFTISRDNAANTVYLQMNSLKPEDTAVYYCNVKDYGAVLYEYDYWGQGTQVTVSSHHHHHH";\nconst NB35_SEQUENCE =\n  "QVQLQESGGGLVQPGGSLRLSCAASGFTFSNYKMNWVRQAPGKGLEWVSDISQSGASISYTGSVKGRFTISRDNAKNTLYLQMNSLKPEDTAVYYCARCPAPFTRDCFDVTSTTYAYRGQGTQVTVSSHHHHHHEPEA";`,
      "Nb35 regression sequence",
    );
  }
  if (!testSource.includes("contract.numbering.completeImgtRegionCoverageRequired")) {
    testSource = replaceOnce(
      testSource,
      `  assert.equal(contract.numbering.minimumEngineConfidence, 0.5);`,
      `  assert.equal(contract.numbering.minimumEngineConfidence, 0.5);\n  assert.equal(contract.numbering.completeImgtRegionCoverageRequired, true);\n  assert.equal(contract.numbering.numberingSegmentationAgreementRequired, true);\n  assert.equal(contract.numbering.packageLockPath, "package-lock.json");\n  assert.match(contract.numbering.packageLockSha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u);\n  assert.equal(contract.numbering.correctionRecordPath, "validation/hard-decoy-holdout-v3/VHH_NUMBERING_CORRECTION_2026-08-30.json");\n  assert.match(contract.numbering.correctionRecordSha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u);`,
      "contract correction assertions",
    );
  }
  if (!testSource.includes("first.completeImgtRegionCoverage")) {
    testSource = replaceOnce(
      testSource,
      `  assert.ok(first.cdr3Length > 0);`,
      `  assert.ok(first.cdr3Length > 0);\n  assert.equal(first.completeImgtRegionCoverage, true);\n  assert.equal(first.numberingSegmentationAgreement, true);\n  assert.ok(Object.values(first.imgtRegionLengths).every((length) => Number.isSafeInteger(length) && length > 0));`,
      "numbering completeness test",
    );
  }
  if (!testSource.includes("preserves the complete Nb35 long CDR3")) {
    testSource = replaceOnce(
      testSource,
      `test("the complete VHH sequence pregraph regenerates, reconciles exact evidence, and fails closed under mutation", { timeout: 600_000 }, async () => {`,
      `test("the corrected pinned IMGT engine preserves the complete Nb35 long CDR3 before a terminal tag", () => {\n  const numbered = numberVhhForLeakage(NB35_SEQUENCE);\n  assert.equal(numbered.numberingStatus, "NUMBERED");\n  assert.equal(numbered.numberingEngine, "immunum 1.3.0");\n  assert.equal(numbered.cdr3Sequence, "ARCPAPFTRDCFDVTSTTYAY");\n  assert.equal(numbered.cdr3Length, 21);\n  assert.equal(numbered.completeImgtRegionCoverage, true);\n  assert.equal(numbered.numberingSegmentationAgreement, true);\n  assert.ok(numbered.imgtRegionLengths["FR4-IMGT"] > 0);\n  assert.ok(numbered.queryEnd < NB35_SEQUENCE.length - 1);\n});\n\ntest("the complete VHH sequence pregraph regenerates, reconciles exact evidence, and fails closed under mutation", { timeout: 600_000 }, async () => {`,
      "long-CDR3 regression test",
    );
  }
  await writeFile(TEST_PATH, testSource);

  let auditSource = await readFile(AUDIT_PATH, "utf8");
  if (!auditSource.includes("profile.completeImgtRegionCoverage")) {
    auditSource = replaceOnce(
      auditSource,
      `      assert.equal(profile.numberingFailureMessage, null, \`${profile.profileId} numbering failure message\`);`,
      `      assert.equal(profile.numberingFailureMessage, null, \`${profile.profileId} numbering failure message\`);\n      assert.equal(profile.completeImgtRegionCoverage, true, \`${profile.profileId} complete IMGT region coverage\`);\n      assert.equal(profile.numberingSegmentationAgreement, true, \`${profile.profileId} numbering/segmentation agreement\`);\n      assert.ok(profile.imgtRegionLengths && Object.values(profile.imgtRegionLengths).every((length) => Number.isSafeInteger(length) && length > 0), \`${profile.profileId} IMGT region lengths\`);`,
      "independent profile completeness audit",
    );
    auditSource = replaceOnce(
      auditSource,
      `      ]) assert.equal(profile[field], null, \`${profile.profileId} unavailable-numbering field ${field}\`);`,
      `      ]) assert.equal(profile[field], null, \`${profile.profileId} unavailable-numbering field ${field}\`);\n      assert.equal(profile.imgtRegionLengths, null, \`${profile.profileId} unavailable IMGT region lengths\`);\n      assert.equal(profile.completeImgtRegionCoverage, false, \`${profile.profileId} unavailable complete-region state\`);\n      assert.equal(profile.numberingSegmentationAgreement, false, \`${profile.profileId} unavailable segmentation-agreement state\`);`,
      "independent unavailable-profile audit",
    );
  }
  if (!auditSource.includes("dependencyPackageLock")) {
    auditSource = replaceOnce(
      auditSource,
      `  const summary = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(SNAPSHOT, "summary.json"), "utf8"));\n  const commitments = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(SNAPSHOT, "pair-space-commitments.json"), "utf8"));`,
      `  const summary = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(SNAPSHOT, "summary.json"), "utf8"));\n  const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(SNAPSHOT, "manifest.json"), "utf8"));\n  const contract = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(ROOT, "validation/hard-decoy-holdout-v3/vhh-sequence-contract-2026-08-29.json"), "utf8"));\n  const commitments = JSON.parse(await readFile(path.join(SNAPSHOT, "pair-space-commitments.json"), "utf8"));\n  assert.equal(manifest.inputDigests.dependencyPackageLock, contract.numbering.packageLockSha256, "Dependency-lock manifest binding");\n  assert.equal(manifest.inputDigests.numberingCorrectionRecord, contract.numbering.correctionRecordSha256, "Correction-record manifest binding");`,
      "independent provenance audit",
    );
  }
  await writeFile(AUDIT_PATH, auditSource);
}

async function bindLock() {
  const lockBytes = await readFile(LOCK_PATH);
  const contract = JSON.parse(await readFile(CONTRACT_PATH, "utf8"));
  contract.numbering.packageLockSha256 = sha256(lockBytes);
  await writeJson(CONTRACT_PATH, contract);
}

const command = process.argv[2];
if (command === "prepare") await prepare();
else if (command === "bind-lock") await bindLock();
else throw new Error("Usage: node scripts/hard-decoy/upgrade-vhh-numbering-v130.mjs <prepare|bind-lock>");
